about_the_game:
"Don’t trust the butcher"

"The Butcher's Village™" is a first-person psychedelic horror game with a heavy focus on atmosphere and disorientation. You play as Murtaza, a man who arrives in a remote village in North America where nothing feels quite right. The people are strange, and the endless heavy rain turns every step into a struggle. The deeper you go, the more the world around you begins to fracture and distort.

IMPORTANT NOTE: The game focuses on exploration and builds tension slowly to create a deeper and more meaningful experience. Its story is unveiled through surreal imaging and subtle environment details. Be mindful that it is a difficult game in unconventional ways.

STORYLINE

A man named Murtaza lives in North America. One rainy evening, he receives a call from his friend, urgently asking him to come to a certain address and help with a troubling situation. Without hesitation, Murtaza gets into his car and drives into the heavy rain. The road is swallowed by thick fog, and the downpour makes it nearly impossible to see. Suddenly, an accident occurs as his car skids and crashes. When he regains consciousness, the vehicle is wrecked and refuses to start. Stranded in the storm, Murtaza sets out on foot in search of help. After a long, uneasy walk through the darkness, he stumbles upon a remote village. In the distance, he sees a lone man digging a ditch, his clothes soaked in blood. Desperate, Murtaza approaches him for help.

The man looks up, expressionless, and says:
“It’s not possible to help you now. The weather is too dangerous. You’ll have to wait until it calms down. For now, stay at my house. Dinner is ready and we can eat together.”

WARNING: This game contains flashing lights, rapid visual effects, and intense imagery that may trigger seizures or other adverse reactions in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy or similar conditions. Player discretion is advised.

GAME FEATURES

  • Psychedelic Horror – Sanity unravels as familiar places shift into bizarre visions, leaving you unsure of what can be trusted.

  • Narrative-Driven Horror – Heavy story focused and the game atmosphere surround you with tension and mystery.

  • The Butcher’s Legacy – A merciless figure whose presence is felt in every corner, through bloodstained tools, broken memory, and traces of his crimes.

  • Surreal Fear – What looks ordinary at first slowly changes into something you can’t explain.

  • Sound Design – Immersive audio wraps around you, raising the tension and slowly drawing you into madness.

HIS KNIFE, YOUR FEAR

No escape from his watch — every step closer to the truth makes his presence sharper, the blood heavier, and the bodies a grim reminder of the butcher’s mess left behind.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of violence that may negatively affect the viewer’s psychological state. Some content may be inappropriate for certain age groups. It is advised to apply suitable age restrictions for the intended audience.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • Storage: 14 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
